title: 第23章满朝大惊临江城粮价低至七十文一斗第24章以工代赈这才是赈灾的王道
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 深夜。
大乾皇宫。
女帝武曌站在窗前，清冷的月光照在那张绝美的面庞上，透着三分清冷，七分疏离。
她的一双眸子弥漫着无尽的高贵。
“难道真是朕看错了吗？”
武曌负手看向远方，那属于临江城的方向，眉头紧蹙。
崔星河到了清水城，不过短短三日时间，清水城的粮价不但被遏制，还骤然下跌。
粮价不但稳定在八十二文一斗，甚至还再降两文，到了八十文一斗。
大灾年间，不但遏制了暴涨的粮价，还令他一跌再跌，这需要不小的本事！
崔星河没有辜负她的信任。
但武曌却并不开心。
“你，让朕有些失望啊！”
武曌脑海中满是高阳站在大殿之中，侃侃而谈的模样，如果说处理仇人之子，只是让她高看一眼。
那之后的戏猴局，就令她动容，甚至是感到一股发自心底的寒意。
这就是她心中一直要找的人！
故此，她搞出了这一场比试，以两城数十万百姓，给他们施展才华的天地，角逐胜负。
甚至在她的心中，她要更看好高阳，故此将灾情更大，城内更复杂的临江城给了高阳。
但临江城粮价一路暴涨，甚至高阳还要在大灾年间重修县衙，举办大型活动，给那些贪婪的商贾减免赋税。
崔星河越是耀眼，高阳就令她越发失望。
“罢了！”
“纸上谈兵，终究不能堪当大任。”
女帝摇摇头，准备休息。
但就在这时，门外的小太监慌张闯了进来。
“上官大人派人快马送来一封信，务必要陛下亲启！”
“不仅如此，杜大人也再次派出快马，送来奏折，并特地嘱咐，这份奏折需陛下亲启，再抄录给御史台！”
小太监跪在地上。
武曌骤然回头，一股恐怖的高贵和威严弥漫在她的周围。
“呈上来！”
武曌眼神闪烁。
上官婉儿派人送了一封信。
杜江也快马送来一份奏折，还全都要她亲启。
难道临江城的民愤压不住了，爆发了一场大乱？
武曌一瞬间想了许多，眼神凝重。
她才刚登基不久，若是此刻爆发战乱，那对她可不是什么好消息。
想到什么，武曌眸子冰冷。
凤鸾宫内，一些嗅觉灵敏的太监和宫女目光在触及到武曌的脸色，更是大气都不敢喘。
武曌先是拆开信封，拿出上官婉儿的亲笔信。
content_en:
late at night.
Daqian Palace.
Empress Wu Zhao stood in front of the window. The cold moonlight shone on that beautiful face, showing a certain amount of coldness and a certain amount of alienation.
Her eyes were filled with endless nobility.
"Did I really see it wrong?"
Wu Zhao put his hands behind his hands and looked into the distance, in the direction of Linjiang City, with a frown.
Cui Xinghe arrived in Qingshui City, but in just three days, the price of food in Qingshui City was not only curbed, but also fell sharply.
Not only did the price of grain remain stable at eighty-two cents per dou, but it even dropped by another two cents, to eighty cents per dou.
During the catastrophic years, not only did it curb the skyrocketing food prices, but it also caused them to fall again and again. This requires no small skill!
Cui Xinghe lived up to her trust.
But Wu Zhao was not happy.
"You make me a little disappointed!"
Wu Zhao's mind was filled with the image of Gao Yang standing in the main hall, talking eloquently. If he was talking about dealing with the son of his enemy, he would just give her a high look.
The monkey show that followed made her moved, and she even felt a chill from the bottom of her heart.
This is the person she has been looking for!
Therefore, she created this competition, using hundreds of thousands of people from the two cities to give them a place to display their talents and compete for the outcome.
Even in her heart, she wanted to be more optimistic about Gao Yang, so she gave Linjiang City, which had a greater disaster and a more complicated city, to Gao Yang.
However, food prices in Linjiang City have skyrocketed, and Gaoyang even had to rebuild the county government office during the disaster years, hold large-scale events, and reduce taxes for greedy merchants.
The more dazzling Cui Xinghe became, the more disappointed Gao Yang became for her.
"That's it!"
"Those who talk on paper will not be able to take on big responsibilities after all."
The empress shook her head and prepared to rest.
But at this moment, the little eunuch outside the door rushed in in a panic.
"Report!"
"Sir Shangguan sent someone to deliver a letter quickly. Your Majesty must sign it personally!"
"Not only that, Mr. Du also sent a fast horse again to deliver the memorial, and specifically asked that this memorial must be personally signed by His Majesty and then copied to the Yushitai!"
The little eunuch knelt on the ground.
Wu Zhao suddenly turned around, and a terrifying sense of nobility and majesty filled her surroundings.
"Send it up!"
Wu Zhao's eyes flickered.
Shangguan Wan'er sent someone to deliver a letter.
Du Jiang also quickly sent a memorial and asked her to sign it personally.
Could it be that the public anger in Linjiang City could no longer be suppressed and a great chaos broke out?
Wu Zhao thought a lot in an instant, his eyes solemn.
She had just ascended the throne, so if war broke out at this moment, it would not be good news for her.
Thinking of something, Wu Zhao's eyes turned cold.
In Fengluan Palace, some eunuchs and maids with keen sense of smell didn't dare to breathe when their eyes touched Wu Zhao's face.
Wu Zhao first opened the envelope and took out Shangguan Wan'er's handwritten letter.
title_en: Chapter 23: The whole court was shocked. The price of food in Linjiang City was as low as 70 cents per dou. Chapter 24: Working for relief is the kingly way to provide disaster relief.
